assumptions.statement: Submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are provisional_constraint geometry from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. They are not official redlines and must be recalculated after organizer official polygons arrive.
assumptions.impact: All area ratios, land-use partitions, and metric values are provisional intake values only; content scoring is not blocked, but statutory use is forbidden.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage lines, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Height, FAR, demolition/renovation conclusions, road alignments, and investment timelines remain concept suggestions for professional teams.

assumptions.statement: Annual AI events, developer community operations, pilgrimage landmarks, and honor walls are conceptual operations proposals, not confirmed government programs.
assumptions.impact: Brand, event, and milestone ideas require organizer/professional review before any public commitment.
